# CharacterCreation

`creation`

What a player chooses when creating a character: a name (rules and uniqueness), a gender (a fixed chibi body preset), a hair style of that gender and a hair colour. Attributes are not chosen; every character starts at base. Cute, chunky chibi figures: a big head, short limbs, bold hair. Our own designs.

> Let a player become a recognisable character in one short screen, generated from data, without a pay or class gate

## Attributes

| Field | Type | Description |
| ----- | ---- | ----------- |
| nameRules | json | Name length, scripts, separators, uniqueness folding and reserved names |
| genders | json | The gender options, in display order |
| presets | json | Gender -> the appearance entity (body, head, eyes, skin, chibi proportions) |
| hair | json | Gender -> hair style ids (each has a UI icon and a mesh at the same key) |
| hairColors | json | The curated hair colour list (palette indices in the hair region) |
| defaultCreation | json | The creation a skipped screen uses |
| startingKit | json | The starting outfit and items per server rule: a plain novice outfit, no class kits |
| chibiHeadRatio | json | Allowed head height / total height of a chibi rig |
